eq-ch08-config-weight: Species molar mass from the elemental composition and the atomic-weight table, in kg/mol.
eq-ch08-radiation-net: Net upward flux at each level: the band sum of upward minus total downward flux.
eq-ch08-radiation-boundary: Surface downward and top upward flux outputs: band sums at the first and last level.
eq-ch08-spherical-doc: Documented spherical flux factor: each layer of the curved column gains the plane-parallel heating.
eq-ch08-spherical-code: Spherical flux factor as the code computes it, without the division by the level flux.
eq-ch08-stepper-tendency: Layer temperature increment from the radiative and diffusive flux divergence.
eq-ch08-stepper-dz: Hypsometric layer thickness from the layer temperature and the level pressures.
eq-ch08-stepper-diffusion: Diffusive heat flux on the interior levels, zero at the surface and the top.
eq-ch08-stepper-surface: Surface temperature increment: absorbed downward flux minus black-body emission.
eq-ch08-stepper-stage: One Runge-Kutta stage as a weighted sum of the step start, the last stage and its tendency.
